q1.explanationZh: shave“剃（胡须）”，shave off one’s beard“剃掉胡子”。

q2.explanationZh: she 是主格，作主语；宾格是 her。

q3.explanationZh: sheep“羊”，单复数同形：one sheep, many sheep。

q4.explanationZh: sheet“薄片；一张”，a sheet of paper“一张纸”。

q5.explanationZh: shelf“架子”，以 -f 结尾的名词变复数把 f 变成 v 再加 -es：shelf → shelves。

q6.explanationZh: shell“壳；贝壳”，注意结尾是双写 ll。

q7.explanationZh: shelter 名词“庇护（所）”，动词“躲避”，shelter from the rain“避雨”。

q8.explanationZh: shift 动词“转移；移动”，名词还可指“轮班”，work shifts“轮班工作”。

q10.explanationZh: ship 名词“船”，by ship“乘船”；动词“用船运”，过去式 shipped。

q11.explanationZh: shirt“衬衫”，注意与 skirt“裙子”区分。

q12.explanationZh: shock 名词“震惊”，动词“使震惊”，be shocked at“对……感到震惊”。

q13.explanationZh: shoe“鞋”，一双鞋是 a pair of shoes。

q14.explanationZh: shoot“射击；拍摄”，shoot a film“拍电影”，过去式 shot。

q15.explanationZh: shop 名词“商店”，动词“购物”，过去式 shopped。

q16.explanationZh: shop“商店”+ keeper“看管的人”= shopkeeper“店主”。

q17.explanationZh: shop 双写 p 加 -er 构成 shopper“购物者”。

q19.explanationZh: short 形容词“短的；矮的”，反义词 long / tall。

q20.explanationZh: short 加 -age 构成名词 shortage“不足，缺少”，a shortage of“……的短缺”。

q21.explanationZh: shortcoming“缺点”，由 short + coming 合成，反义 strong point / strength。

q22.explanationZh: shortcut“捷径”，由 short + cut 合成，take a shortcut“抄近路”。

q23.explanationZh: short 加动词后缀 -en 构成 shorten“缩短”。

q24.explanationZh: short 加 -ly 构成副词 shortly“不久”，shortly afterwards“不久以后”。

q25.explanationZh: short“短”+ sighted“视力……的”= shortsighted“近视的”。

q26.explanationZh: shorts“短裤”，总是用复数形式，a pair of shorts“一条短裤”。

q27.explanationZh: shot 名词“射击”，也是 shoot 的过去式和过去分词。

q28.explanationZh: should 是情态动词，表示“应该”，后接动词原形。

q29.explanationZh: shoulder 名词“肩膀”，动词“承担”，shoulder the responsibility“承担责任”。

q30.explanationZh: shout“呼喊”，既可作动词也可作名词。

q31.explanationZh: show 动词“给……看；显示”，名词“展览；演出”，过去分词 shown。

q32.explanationZh: shower“阵雨；淋浴”，take a shower“洗淋浴”。

q34.explanationZh: “一张纸”= a sheet of paper，sheet 表示“一张（纸）”。

q35.explanationZh: shelter from“躲避……”，shelter from trouble“避开麻烦”。

q36.explanationZh: “购物”= do shopping，shopping 是 shop 的动名词形式。

q37.explanationZh: short of“缺少；不足”，be short of money“缺钱”。

q38.explanationZh: “在……后不久”= shortly after 或 soon after。

accept: be wounded by a shot in the leg
wounded by a shot in the leg

q39.explanationZh: shot“射击；枪击”，be wounded by a shot“被枪打伤”，in the leg“在腿上”。

q40.explanationZh: “肩并肩”= shoulder by shoulder（也说 shoulder to shoulder）。

q41.explanationZh: “带某人参观某处”= show sb. around sp.，人放在 show 和 around 之间。

q42.explanationZh: show off“炫耀”，show off sth.“炫耀某物”。

q44.explanationZh: on show“在展出中”，介词 on 表示状态。

q45.explanationZh: be caught in“遇上（雨等）”，shower“阵雨”。

q46.explanationZh: shoot at“朝……射击”（不一定射中）；shoot sb. 则表示“射中某人”。

q47.explanationZh: shout at sb. 带有生气、责骂的意思。

q48.explanationZh: shout to sb. 只是大声喊让对方听见，没有生气的意思。

q49.explanationZh: a white 后接可数名词单数，“穿白衬衫的人”，填 shirt。

q50.explanationZh: “她把椅子向床移近”，shift“移动”，叙述过去的事用过去式 shifted。

q51.explanationZh: “整个上午都在买外套”，shop 作动词“购物”，过去式双写 p：shopped。

q53.explanationZh: The 和 of 之间填名词，“爆炸的冲击”= the shock of the blast。

q54.explanationZh: had orders to 后接动词原形，“向袭击者开枪”，填 shoot。

q55.explanationZh: a shortage of“……的短缺”，“因为弹药短缺而战败”。

q56.explanationZh: shortly afterwards“不久以后”，句首首字母大写。

q57.explanationZh: had to 后接动词原形，shoulder the responsibility“承担责任”。

q58.explanationZh: A sudden 后接名词单数，“一声突然的呼喊”，shout 作名词。

q59.sampleAnswer: Not being punctual is his greatest shortcoming.
references: Not being punctual is his greatest shortcoming.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q59.explanationZh: “缺点”= shortcoming；动名词短语 Not being punctual 作主语。

q60.sampleAnswer: Shortly after the tourists arrived in China, delicious food aroused their appetites.
references: Shortly after the tourists arrived in China, delicious food aroused their appetites.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q60.explanationZh: “在……后不久”= shortly after，后接从句；“使胃口大开”可用 arouse one’s appetite。

q61.sampleAnswer: It is the government’s responsibility to provide safe shelter and food for the people.
references: It is the government’s responsibility to provide safe shelter and food for the people.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q61.explanationZh: “住所”= shelter；用 It is ... to do 形式主语句型，provide sth. for sb.“为某人提供某物”。

q62.sampleAnswer: The old man used to raise many sheep to make a living in the west of China.
references: The old man used to raise many sheep to make a living in the west of China.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q62.explanationZh: sheep 单复同形；“过去常常”= used to do，“谋生”= make a living。

q63.sampleAnswer: With technological advancements, anyone can shoot a video and upload it to the platform.
references: With technological advancements, anyone can shoot a video and upload it to the platform.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: “拍视频”= shoot a video；“随着……”= with ...。

q64.sampleAnswer: We are not accustomed to seeing so many kinds of goods in the shop.
references: We are not accustomed to seeing so many kinds of goods in the shop.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: “商店”= shop；be accustomed to doing“习惯于做”，to 是介词，后接动名词。

q65.sampleAnswer: I was shocked at the news of her death.
references: I was shocked at the news of her death.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.sampleAnswer: She tried to calm down and not to show her excitement.
references: She tried to calm down and not to show her excitement.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: show“显露（情绪）”；不定式的否定 not to do。

q67.sampleAnswer: More people showed up for our opening ceremony than we had expected.
references: More people showed up for our opening ceremony than we had expected.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q67.explanationZh: show up“出席，露面”；“预料”发生在来人之前，用过去完成时 had expected。

q68.sampleAnswer: After we have experienced failure after failure, we realize that there is no shortcut in doing anything and we won’t succeed unless we work hard.
references: After we have experienced failure after failure, we realize that there is no shortcut in doing anything and we won’t succeed unless we work hard.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q68.explanationZh: “捷径”= shortcut；“非……不可”可用 not ... unless ...。
